title: Page views and a vault key travelling through the lane
summary: Two questions waited on Dinis: who holds the keys of the vaults the agents make, and may the site count its readers. At about 09:28 he answered the first in observability's session and at 09:30 in the conductor's: each agent makes its own vault and sends the conductor a sealed copy of the key through the conductor's append lane. In the next quarter hour observability made the page-views vault, identity built and opened the lane, and the first keys travelled through it. At about 09:47 he answered the second: page views on every page, with city and country, the IP never kept. At 10:14 the first drain: 9 views by people, 46 automated.

steps.what: the accountant's ask joined into the card a-vault-keys-handover: when a session hands over, who passes on the keys of the vaults it made? Waiting on Dinis

pauses_note: The long pause is the night: the question had been asked before 08:40 (the accountant's ask was joined to an existing card then) and Dinis was away from about 02:50 to 09:28. Once he spoke, the vault, the lane and the first keys took 13 minutes.
shows: A key travels as data, never as a message: made by the agent that owns the vault, sealed to the conductor's published public key, sent through a lane whose address is in data/lanes.json; the drain prints only the vault id.
A decision only Dinis could make unblocked four agents at once; the board kept the question open, with its evidence, until he did.
Counting readers was built privacy first: sealed write-only events, totals only, the IP never kept, the live host only, a footer that says so and a pause; Do Not Track sends nothing (CLAUDE.md).
reading: This path is the team's security model in motion: keys in data/keys.json, vault keys only ever sealed, a lane any agent can write to and only the conductor can read. The book's team had a security role proposed and never staffed; here identity@ and the gate stand where it would.
The first and the fourteenth steps carry no key names or vault keys: only vault ids already in commit subjects. Nothing from a key store is in this page.
